text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-T-T!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer!! Were you watching?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
1,600m... I ran the whole way! Not only 
that, I actually won!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, even a mile was a long 
distance for Sakura Bakushin O... but she 
grew magnificently and overcame it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, looking back, this was an 
inevitable destiny. Because I am the Class 
Rep, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I always knew I was a capable girl, but 
really... I'm just too amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah... Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your talent blooming has finally gone full 
Bakushin, hasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's something I just 
realized!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Prepare to be amazed! After all my hard 
work over these past three years, I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was able to extend the distance by a 
whole 400 meters!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If I just keep bakushin-ing like this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you divide 3000m by 400m, I think 
the zeros go away, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Anyway!! Give me 10 years and I'll win 
every single race!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: 10 YEARSSSSSS?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh, that? Um... huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, if I just keep bakushin-ing like 
this, I'll be able to win every race from 
here on out... maybe... or definitely not 
impossible!
choice_data_list:
Not sweating the small stuff is what being 
Class Rep is all about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hah! You're right!
choice_data_list: Keep this up and aim for the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooo... OOOOOOHH!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will aim for it! Of course I will 
aim for it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you, Trainer, it will 
definitely come true!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep Bakushin-ing forward together 
from here on out, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nice chant! Let's do it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's challenge is far from 
over...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "BAKUSHIIIIIIIN!!!!"
